text:
morgan: deploy-bot flagged a canary failure for checkout-api in prod

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] helm canary update failed for chart=checkout-api version=2.4.0-canary.5
Error summary: values.secret reference mismatch -> secret 'checkout-api-tls' not found in namespace 'prod'

dmitri: can you paste the helm diff / error logs?

morgan: here's the diff we got from the canary job:
```diff
- secretName: checkout-api-tls
+ secretName: checkout-api-tls-v2
```

jess: looks like values were bumped to expect rotated secret name, cluster still has old secret. Did the secret-sync job run? :eyes:

tara: this is inside our 09:00-11:00 change window; canary started at 09:04. given the config drift risk i'd vote abort canary and roll back to the pinned chart until secrets are synced.

sre-oncall: +1. Risk of half the fleet pointing at missing secret = 502s. Abort canary and pin to last stable. Also open incident and notify infra.

morgan: running rollback command now:
```bash
helm rollback checkout-api 2 --namespace prod || kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/checkout-api
```

deploy-bot: action=rollback status=ok helm_release=checkout-api revision=2 timestamp=2026-03-20T09:12:19Z

dmitri: after rollback we should pin chart version for at least 24h and disable auto-canary for this chart until secret rotation completes.

jess: also adding a preflight that verifies secrets referenced in values exist before starting canary. fail-fast beats noisy rollbacks.

morgan: created PR #482 to add the preflight check and add chart-version pinning to the release controller. tagging @release-team for review.

tara: opening incident INC-2026 to track secret rotation and recovery steps. asking infra to run secret-sync across regions and to verify KMS access.

sre-oncall: marking rollout blocked. assign: dmitri -> verify PR and patch, morgan -> coordinate canary re-run once infra confirms secret sync.

morgan: ack, will update this thread when canary is re-scheduled. :thumbsup:

(quick notes) jess: follow-up actions -> add preflight check, add canary guardrail for missing secrets, add alert to surface values/secret mismatches to release channel.

morgan: thanks everyone, abort/rollback worked and cluster is stable. will re-run canary after infra confirms secret exists and smoke tests pass. :white_check_mark:
